objectives.joint_spectral: quiet teacher MSE/q0 + preservation_weight * nonquiet frozen-baseline MSE/a0 + calibrated_weight * pooled teacher linear/log mel
objectives.joint_wave: quiet teacher MSE/q0 + preservation_weight * nonquiet frozen-baseline MSE/a0

identity.scope: Matched existing-layer/spectral-supervision factorial, not a full GAN/Muon continuation. No synthetic fit, tanh, gate, new layer or automatic promotion.
identity.spectral_region_policy: Intact valid STFT windows classified by fixed teacher quiet mask into entirely quiet, entirely active, or mixed. Scored spans shorter than largest FFT omitted from spectral loss only and accounted.

rate-calibration.policy: First training batch; at most six halvings; identical rate for all four arms. Temporary candidate updates discarded; calibration batches replayed in one-pass fit.

spectral-calibration.policy: sqrt(sum wave-output-gradient energy / sum mel-output-gradient energy) on first four fixed training batches. Shared by both spectral arms; no parameter-gradient scope advantage. Preservation derivative is zero at baseline; initial balance is quiet teacher versus all-valid teacher mel and will change during fitting.
